channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Tech stocks slide as Wall Street chip rout spreads. SK Hynix, SoftBank and ASML slump
item.description: Technology stocks tumbled Tuesday as a sell-off in U.S. semiconductor shares spilled into Asian and European markets.

item.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen
item.description: The IMF says risks in the government bond market have worsened and that yields could jump sharply and disorderly.

item.title: Oil prices fall as traders assess Russian diesel supply prospects and Saudi-Houthi conflict
item.description: Oil prices fell as investors assess potential supply disruptions against prospects of more Russian diesel entering global markets.

item.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
item.description: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.

item.title: Cyber attack hits hundreds of French supermarkets, heating fridges to 122°F and sparking fires
item.description: Hackers targeted hundreds of French supermarkets in a large-scale cyberattack, causing refrigerators to overheat, spoiling food, and sparking fires.

item.title: Visa gets Beijing's green light for bank card business after 40 years of working with China
item.description: The incremental approval comes as the U.S. and Chinese presidents are due to meet for a third time this year next month.

item.title: CNBC Daily Open: 'Boring' trumps disorder and volatility
item.description: Some warning lights are flashing on the global economy dashboard.

item.title: Six Flags shares plunge after-hours following report of deadly roller coaster incident
item.description: Six Flags shares plunged more than 10% in after-hours trading Monday following reports of a deadly roller coaster incident at its Georgia amusement park.

item.title: How Red Bull's F1 team is using AI to make split-second decisions for Max Verstappen
item.description: Red Bull Racing is increasingly using AI to help make real-time Formula 1 race decisions, but the team says human judgment remains essential.

item.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: How a gold-buying spree helps the yuan go global
item.description: Plans to develop a gold trading hub in Hong Kong coincide with China's growing gold reserves.

item.title: FAA warns U.S. airlines of safety risks over Saudi Arabia after attacks
item.description: The FAA warned U.S. airlines about flight risks over Saudi Arabia as Riyadh airport attacks disrupt travel and Delta weighs an Oct. 23 launch.

item.title: e.l.f. Beauty CEO Tarang Amin on why it ‘never hurts to have a conversation’
item.description: e.l.f. Beauty CEO Tarang Amin reflects on why he initially dismissed the opportunity to lead the cosmetics company before changing his mind, and how it reinforced his belief that it never hurts to have a conversation. He also discusses his immigrant upbringing, curiosity, leadership, diversity and the decisions that shaped his career.

item.title: Trump defends Russia diesel deal after bipartisan pushback: 'I made the right choice'
item.description: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that the U.S. easing sanctions on Moscow "plays into Russia's hands."

item.title: Singapore PM Wong rejects weaker currency as shortcut to competitiveness
item.description: Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong pushed back against the idea of weakening the city-state's currency to boost competitiveness.

item.title: Rep. Ilhan Omar blasts federal criminal raid on home: 'I will not be silenced'
item.description: The Minnesota Democrat, a Muslim who was born in Somalia, has been targeted for criticism in the past by President Donald Trump.

item.title: Katie Stockton says retail stocks could be primed for a counter-trend rally. These stocks may lead the bounce
item.description: Retail stocks are stabilizing following their recent correction.

item.title: As 'Cockroach' protests grow over alleged voter fraud, Modi defends India as ‘mother of democracy’

item.description: Singapore is a bastion of safety amid global turmoil, according to the CEO of DBS.

item.title: Elon Musk gives $276 million to Republican groups, becomes biggest known 2026 midterm donor
item.description: Musk’s record midterm election spending comes as the Tesla and SpaceX CEO rebuilds his relationship with Trump and has business ties to the federal government.

item.title: Delta delays debut of Saudi Arabia service until March after Riyadh airport attacks
item.description: Delta planned to begin the route on Oct. 23, in what would have marked the first nonstop commercial flight between the U.S. and Saudi Arabia.

item.title: GM CEO: We're making leaps and bounds toward 'eyes-off, hands-off' driving
item.description: General Motors CEO Mary Barra said that the automaker is still on track to introduce "eyes-off, hands-off" driving technology by 2028.
